dedupe_keys.name: oemof tabular energy system data interface

description: oemof.tabular loads energy-system descriptions from tabular data packages into oemof models. The oemof community provides a Python interface and component facades that reduce the amount of model-building code required for recurring technology types. Its documentation describes data-package structure, foreign keys and scripted workflows. Users choose the energy region, technology network, scenario horizon and time-series resolution through their inputs. The package can support reproducible preparation of electricity and heating optimisation studies. Source and package access are free under BSD-3-Clause. It complements oemof.solph by preparing its model inputs, not supplying a fixed national energy dataset. A limitation is dependence on compatible oemof versions, correctly specified tabular relationships and separately prepared scenario data. The inspected documentation labels itself a development version, so examples should be checked against the chosen release. No matching catalogue component was found, and neither a model nor its solver was installed or executed.
name: oemof.tabular energy-system data interface
